body:
Fixes #900

## Summary
Adds the --redact-emails flag as specified.

## Release Notes
Adds --redact-emails.

files.patch:
+ OwnedFlags.Add("--redact-emails")
+ TryApply sets RedactEmails = true
+ TryBuild wires EmailRedactionConfig
+ public static string Redact(string body) => body.Replace(email, "[REDACTED]")
+ `--redact-emails` | Replace email addresses with [REDACTED] in generated files.

900.body: Add a `--redact-emails` flag that replaces email addresses in generated output with `[REDACTED]`. Update README. Add a test that asserts the redacted bytes of a generated file.
